page.notes: Uncertain readings: "Dam^h" in line 7 (superscript letter unclear, possibly h or n). "profisci Pontimus" in the last-but-one line: the long s forms are hard to separate and the word "Pontimuss" may be printed with a double s. "possf." (Sanctimonialis line) and "Illumi" are copied as they appear, with superscript letters rendered as shown. The woodcut-style decorated initials on Quidquid, Viam, An sit, Quod and Cui are ornamental; the first letters are copied as plain letters. The catchword "Quid" is at the bottom right.
